# Key Formulas & Definitions
Stress = Force / Area

# Practice Problems
1. A 10 N force acts on 2 square metres. Find the stress.

# Answer Key
1. 5 pascals

scenes.title: STRESS IN STRUCTURES
scenes.subtitle: Lesson 01
scenes.narration: Welcome to Strength of Materials. Today we meet stress.

scenes.title: WHAT IS STRESS?
scenes.html:
Stress is force per unit area.

It is measured in pascals.
scenes.narration: [SYNC] Stress is the force acting on each unit of area. [PAUSE:1] [SYNC] Look at this diagram. [SYNC] We measure stress in pascals.

scenes.title: SQUEEZING A BLOCK
scenes.manim_code:
from manim import *

class SqueezeBlock(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        block = Square(side_length=2, color=YELLOW, fill_opacity=0.4)
        self.play(Create(block))
        self.play(block.animate.stretch(0.5, 1), run_time=1.5)
        self.wait(0.5)
scenes.narration: Watch the block get squeezed as the load grows.

scenes.title: LOADS IN THE REAL WORLD
scenes.narration: Bridges carry huge loads every single day.

scenes.title: CHECKPOINT
scenes.question: What is the unit of stress?
scenes.narration: Quick check. What is the unit of stress?
scenes.reveal_narration: It is the pascal. Well done.
